_comment: Committed contract for the waste-law retrieval eval. Measured 2026-07-22 against collection waste_management_law_mk_v2 (3950 chunks, 46 laws) with intfloat/multilingual-e5-large at top_k=6: 9/9 = 1.000, 8 of 9 at rank 1. With 9 cases one case is worth 0.111, so a 0.85 floor tolerates exactly one miss (8/9 = 0.889) and fails at two (7/9 = 0.778). Raising this after a green run locks the gain in; lowering it accepts a regression and must be its own reviewable diff.
